Craftsman style townhome beautifully built by Pahlisch Homes. Townhome has warm gas fireplace with slate surround in living room, and upstairs -three bedrooms, two and half bathrooms, with an loft area in the center. Kitchen features Quartz countertops with under mount sink, breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, and laminate wood flooring. Ample dining area also. Nice great room gives that extra spacious feeling. Extra storage space under the stairs. 2 Extra large cupboards in the kitchen make great pantry areas. Besides a two car garage with an alley access, it has a fenced in private paver courtyard in the front. Carpet on stairs and in bonus area to be changed to hardwood laminate flooring. Bedrooms shall remain carpeted. Master has a great walk in closet with windows for extra lighting. Washer/Dryer included in upstairs laundry room. Small pets may be considered with rental history and additional security deposit. Includes A/C Tenant responsible for all utilities Security Deposit subject to change. Applications available at www.hummingbirdpropertymanagement.com Please read the criteria carefully located under Apply Here, then proceed to application. Fee not required initially.
